Energy class C meets the stated preference, while the high public transport proximity percentile (95.26) aligns strongly with the mobility preference. These data do not establish capacity for 60 people, room layouts, authorization, or technical feasibility; each requires verification. The grant-specific standards include net residential area per bed and other dimensional requirements, but the supplied regulatory result identifies no verified minimum gross property area. Turin planning compatibility, change-of-use authorization, hygiene, accessibility, fire safety where required, structural safety, and sector authorization must be checked.

These figures support further investigation but do not establish capacity for 60 people, suitable room layouts, accessibility, or conversion feasibility. The grant standard provided specifies net residential area per bed and room, including 10.6 sqm per bed in a single room or 8.1 sqm per bed in a double room; it provides no verified minimum gross property area. Eligibility and feasibility therefore require checking the property's net usable areas and the listed planning, building, health, accessibility, fire-safety, structural, and sector authorization requirements.
